context_research_questions.text: Which sector peers report adjusted EBITDA after lease costs?
Do the supplied notes expect input cost pressure on producers to rise or ease?

model_tailored.text: The issuer reports a single operating segment. Which producers supply the sector covered by the supplied notes, and how concentrated is supply?
The issuer reports adjusted EBITDA equal to reported EBITDA with no add-backs. How do producers in the sector define adjusted EBITDA?
What trading level or spread figure do the supplied items state for the sector?
How have customers' orders and shipments in the sector moved over the latest year?
The issuer's capital expenditure is entirely maintenance. How are producers in the sector structured by size and product focus?
Which licensing or other regulatory rules bear on producers in the sector?
